In the gamerip tracklist, track 23 is "Super Fighting Techniques (MVS Title)," and "Rear Waterway" (track 7) appears to be the stage that may correspond to the "Docks" location. The official 33-track CD release has track 23 as "Hayate" (a character voice). **Conclusion**: Kizuna Encounter: Super Tag Battle is the strongest match for all specified criteria, though the specific detail about "Docks" being track 23 could not be conclusively verified from available sources.
